Every public law family the pinned `Fuaran.Core.Conformance` **0.18.0** ships, and how this repo answers for it.

A family with no row fails the suite, and so does a row naming a family the pinned kit no
longer ships — enrolment is by name AND by reflection, and the two are checked against
each other. `Carried by phase` is an enrolment a named roadmap phase will flip to
`Adopted` when it ships.
